ns2:course.label: Medieval British Literatures
ns2:course.description: Survey of the multilingual literatures of the British Isles during the Middle Ages, focusing on Old and Middle English (exclusive of Chaucer) but with some attention to Insular Latin, Anglo-Norman, and Celtic (Irish, Scottish, and Welsh) literatures. Texts will be read in Modern English translation, though some Middle English texts may be read in the original. Same as CWL 417 and MDVL 410. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: One year of college literature or consent of instructor.
